notes.title: Update 7 - Hammer hotfix
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31161206/6e99a46d929fddcc9b680f1828746bb659ac1fca.gif[/img]

One of our devs made a last minute change, before sending the latest update, that prevented players from grabbing the hammer.

Once we received the report, we proceeded to make this hotfix and to whip our dev for not testing the entire build after making changes.


[b]Changelog:[/b]
= Hammer can be grabbed again (reported by [url=https://www.twitch.tv/shiabun]@ShiaBun[/url] while watching [url=https://www.twitch.tv/popskyy]@popskyy[/url] stream)


Sorry for those who went crazy trying to figure out how to grab it.

Found any bug? We have a forum section to report them! :)

notes.title: Update 6 - Improve savegame system & polish details
notes.content:
Today we've spend most of the day improving the savegame system to avoid future savegame breaking builds and polishing details.

Changelog:
+ Ignore click events if player is viewing a menu
+ Windows: Allow changing windows color
+ Track triggered dialogs
+ More missing english translations
= Improve savegame system (hopefully there will be no more breaking savegame builds)
= Computer: Fix not working properly after restarting it
= Computer: Fix read emails not being saved on
= MoneyzGone: Change EUR to USD
= Phone dialog didn't trigger if player closed smartphone too early

If everything goes as expected, this will be the last build to break your savegame.

Found any bug? We have a forum section to report them! :)
http://steamcommunity.com/app/740170/discussions/1/

Got an idea to improve the game? We're happy to read it!
http://steamcommunity.com/app/740170/discussions/0/
